notes: «[ عن عبد الله بن المغيرة ]» is an editorial bracket inside the text, and the name is written in it: it is read as a link, since the text writes it
«أبي» is the compiler's father (relation); «(2)» and «(3)» are footnote numbers and are left out
«فسألت النبي عن الوسيلة» is the Companion's own question; the Prophet is the end of the chain and is not a link
